rationale: The schema change renames the `name` field to `display_name` in v1. The C# code uses generated protobuf bindings, so all references to `decoded.Name` and `new Simulation.V1.Entity { Name = ... }` must be updated to use the new property name (`DisplayName`). This is a direct rename migration with no type conversion or logic changes required.
assumptions: The generated C# protobuf bindings will expose `DisplayName` as the renamed property for v1 entities
No additional runtime behavior depends on the old field name beyond its access in this file
